# DUMI / DODOMI Sheepskin — Jinan Carstauto Accessories Co., Ltd

> Sheepskin manufacturer in Jinan, China (founded 1997). 200 product lines across 34 categories
> under two brands: DUMI (home, baby, care, medical) and DODOMI (automotive, riding, car care).
> Factory-direct OEM / ODM for importers worldwide. Site available in 7 languages
> (en, zh, es, de, ja, ru, ar).

Key facts
- Minimum order: 50 pcs from stock, 500 pcs for OEM production.
- Lead time: stock 5-7 days; OEM 25-35 days after sample approval.
- Material: natural Australian / New Zealand sheepskin, formaldehyde-free tanning, imported German dyes.
- Quality: 10-point inspection per batch; SGS test reports on file (azo dyes not detected).
- Certifications: ISO 9000, SGS, REACH.
- Contact: carstcover@aliyun.com · WhatsApp +61 493 342 108 · Tel +86-531-82030000 · Jinan CBD, Shandong, China.
- Pricing: quotation only (no public price list) — request via https://dumi-sheepskin.com/quote/
